ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:0.original: Huh? What happened to our living expenses?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:0.translation: Хм? Что случилось с нашими деньгами на жизнь?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:1.original: What are you talking about? Oh, you're right! You know who the culprit is... Right, Dad?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:1.translation: О чём ты говоришь? О, точно! Ты же знаешь, кто виноват... Правда, папа?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:2.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:2.original: Gah! High quality brushes were on sale. I couldn't help myself. I'll pay it back!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:2.translation: Гах! Кисти высокого качества были на распродаже. Не смог удержаться. Я всё верну!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:3.original: Gah, dummy-daddy! You need to stop wasting money!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:3.translation: Гах, глупый папа! Хватит транжирить деньги!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:4.original: Yeah, I'm angry too. I just want to stuff him in a barrel and...
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:4.translation: Да, я тоже зла. Просто хочется засунуть его в бочку и...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:6.original: Bah, what should we do? We don't have enough for food!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:6.translation: Ба, что нам делать? На еду не хватает!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:7.original: We can't touch the atelier capital, either. I guess it really is back to the soup train!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:7.translation: Капитал ателье мы тоже не можем трогать. Похоже, снова придётся жить на супе!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:8.original: No, please! That stuff is disgusting!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:9.original: But we just don't have the money. You'll just have to grin and bear it, Sue.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:9.translation: Но денег просто нет. Придётся стиснуть зубы и терпеть, Сью.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:10.original: Uwah, Dad! Fine! I've made up my mind. I'm going to save up lots of money!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:10.translation: Ува, папа! Ладно! Я всё решила. Я накоплю кучу денег!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:11.original: So much money that even Dad can't spend it all! We're going to be super rich!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:11.translation: Столько, что даже папа не сможет всё потратить! Мы станем супербогатыми!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:12.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:12.original: Rich! Being able to eat as much as we want, and not have to wear moth-eaten clothes! And...
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:12.translation: Богатыми! Есть сколько хочешь и не носить одежду, изъеденную молью! И...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:13.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:13.original: Dream bigger, Lydie. We'll live in a mansion like a castle, and have butlers and maids!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:13.translation: Мечтай шире, Лиди. Будем жить в особняке как в замке, с дворецкими и горничными!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:14.original: In any case, let's start saving. Even just a little at a time is better than nothing.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_010.ebm:14.translation: В любом случае, начнём копить. Даже понемногу — уже лучше, чем ничего.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:0.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:0.original: One, two, three... Hehe! We are really starting to get pretty rich now!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:0.translation: Раз, два, три... Хе-хе! Мы и правда начинаем богатеть!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:1.original: Yes, it's working! All this money is giving me a tummy ache!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:1.translation: Да, получается! От всех этих денег у меня аж живот болит!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:2.original: Really? Just this wad of notes? We need to aim higher! To be super, super rich!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:2.translation: Правда? Из-за этой пачки купюр? Нам нужно целиться выше! Стать супер-супербогатыми!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:3.original: Yes! Yes! We can't become accustomed to this life without money.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:3.translation: Да! Да! Мы не должны привыкать к жизни без денег.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:4.original: What can we do to make more? Just cutting back isn't enough. To be mega rich...
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:4.translation: Как заработать ещё? Одной экономии мало. Чтобы стать мегабогатыми...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:5.original: Yes, mega rich! What can we do? A way to make some money? Ah, I know!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:5.translation: Да, мегабогатыми! Что можно сделать? Как заработать? Ах, знаю!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:6.original: How about we sell pictures of ourselves? We're so cute, I bet they'd sell!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:6.translation: А что, если продавать наши портреты? Мы такие милые — наверняка купят!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:7.original: Pictures? No, that'll never work. No one would buy a picture of me.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:7.translation: Портреты? Нет, это никогда не сработает. Никто не купит портрет меня.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:8.original: They would, too! You just need to put yourself out there a little more!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:8.translation: Ещё как купят! Тебе просто нужно чуть больше себя показать!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:9.original: N-No, no way! I'm against that, totally! We'll save up some other way!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:9.translation: Н-нет, ни за что! Я категорически против! Будем копить как-нибудь иначе!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:10.original: Gah, very well! We'll just keep crawling along like this for a while, then.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_020.ebm:10.translation: Гах, ладно! Тогда пока продолжим ползти в таком темпе.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:0.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:0.original: Hahaha! Money! Look at all this money!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:1.original: This much money means we can eat all the cake and pudding we want! I can buy every book I want!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:1.translation: Столько денег — и можно есть сколько угодно тортов и пудингов! Купить любую книгу!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:2.original: Tell me about it! Gorgeous dresses, beautiful rings. We can buy whatever we want!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:2.translation: Ещё бы! Шикарные платья, красивые кольца. Купим всё, что захотим!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:3.original: This is a market economy! Money makes all the difference! Sue, isn't money great?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:3.translation: Это рыночная экономика! Деньги решают всё! Сью, разве деньги — не чудо?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:4.original: You said it, Sister! Money is almost as almighty as alchemy!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:4.translation: Точно, сестра! Деньги почти так же всесильны, как алхимия!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:5.original: Once we reach these numbers, though, I just want more! How can we make even more money?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:5.translation: Но когда цифры уже такие, хочется ещё больше! Как заработать ещё?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:6.original: Hmm. Is there someone who can give us some ideas? Who do we know who's rich... Lucia?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:6.translation: Хм. Кто мог бы подсказать идеи? Кого мы знаем из богатых... Люсию?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:8.original: A shop? We already run one of those, don't we?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:8.translation: Магазин? У нас же уже есть один, разве нет?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:9.original: No. I mean a larger, more shoppy shop! If we bring in more customers, we can make more money!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:9.translation: Нет. Я про магазин покрупнее и посерьёзнее! Если привлечём больше покупателей — заработаем больше!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:10.original: I see. To truly become rich, we have to increase our income.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:10.translation: Понятно. Чтобы по-настоящему разбогатеть, нужно увеличить доход.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:11.original: Yes, that's not a bad idea. But can we just go ahead and open a shop like that?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:11.translation: Да, идея неплохая. Но разве можно просто так взять и открыть такой магазин?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:12.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:12.original: Hmm, maybe not. We should ask Mireille.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:12.translation: Хм, наверное нет. Надо спросить Мирей.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:13.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:13.original: Good idea. She'll probably know a lot about that kind of thing, too.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:13.translation: Хорошая идея. Она наверняка много знает и об этом.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:14.original: Right! Wealth, here we come! To Mireille!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_030.ebm:14.translation: Точно! Богатство, мы идём! К Мирей!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:0.speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:0.original: Hello, twins. What's up? Your eyes seem to be sparkling even more brilliantly than usual...
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:0.translation: Здравствуйте, близнецы. Что случилось? Глаза у вас сверкают ещё ярче обычного...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:1.original: Here's the thing. We want to make more money, and to do that, we want to open a bigger shop!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:1.translation: Вот в чём дело. Мы хотим зарабатывать больше — и для этого открыть магазин побольше!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:2.original: We're here to ask if we need a special permit or something like that?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:2.translation: Мы пришли спросить: нужно ли для этого особое разрешение или что-то такое?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:3.speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:3.original: O-okay, okay. I get the gist, no need to keep shouting.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:3.translation: О-хорошо, хорошо. Я поняла суть, не надо кричать.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:4.speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:4.original: Ahem. If I skip to the end, basically, you need a permit to open a large shop, yes.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:4.translation: Кхм. Если коротко: да, чтобы открыть крупный магазин, нужно разрешение.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:5.original: Ah, I knew it! Is there an exam or something?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:5.translation: Ах, я так и знала! Там экзамен или что-то вроде?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:6.speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:6.original: No, nothing like that. You just have to buy a Business License.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:6.translation: Нет, ничего такого. Нужно просто купить лицензию на ведение бизнеса.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:7.original: Buy one? Spend money to make money, you mean? I guess money really does make the world go round.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:7.translation: Купить? То есть потратить деньги, чтобы заработать деньги? Похоже, деньги и правда правят миром.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:8.original: How can we make money, if we need money first before we can start making it?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:8.translation: Как же зарабатывать, если сначала нужны деньги, чтобы вообще начать?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:9.speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:9.original: The two of you seem a bit focused on money, all of a sudden. Did something happen?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:9.translation: Вы двое вдруг так зациклились на деньгах. Что-то случилось?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:10.speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:10.original: Anyway. We issue the licenses here. One of them will cost you about this much.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:10.translation: Как бы то ни было. Лицензии мы выдаём здесь. Одна обойдётся примерно вот в такую сумму.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:11.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:11.original: T-T-That's expensive! It costs that much?!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:12.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:12.original: This is crazy! Just a piece of paper costs that much?!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:12.translation: Это безумие! Просто бумажка — и столько?!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:13.speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:13.original: Hu-huh... "Concessions", "vested interests"... The adult world is a lot more complex than you think.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:13.translation: Угу... «Льготы», «заинтересованные стороны»... Взрослый мир куда сложнее, чем вы думаете.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:15.speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:15.original: That's the situation, anyway. You need a permit. That permit will never get cheaper.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:15.translation: Во всяком случае, так обстоят дела. Вам нужно разрешение. И дешевле оно не станет.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:16.speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:16.original: I'll call in the supervising member of my staff. Talk to them if you want to buy one.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:16.translation: Я позову ответственного сотрудника. Если захотите купить — поговорите с ним.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:17.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:17.original: All right. We've come this far, so we can't give up now!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:17.translation: Ладно. Мы зашли так далеко — сдаваться нельзя!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:18.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:18.original: You said it! We'll open a massive store, make lots of money, and buy books up to the ceiling!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_040.ebm:18.translation: Точно! Откроем огромный магазин, заработаем кучу денег и накупим книг до потолка!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:0.speaker: Lady Official
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:0.original: Do you wish to purchase a Business License for a large store?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:0.translation: Желаете приобрести лицензию на ведение бизнеса для крупного магазина?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:1.speaker: Lady Official
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:1.original: Hold it. You don't have enough money. I'm sorry, no discount allowed on this.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:1.translation: Подождите. У вас недостаточно денег. Извините, скидки на это не предусмотрено.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:2.speaker: Lady Official
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:2.original: Very good. Here's your Business License.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:2.translation: Отлично. Вот ваша лицензия на ведение бизнеса.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:3.original: Uwah, we really did it. Spending so much on this!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:3.translation: Ува, мы и правда это сделали. Потратить столько...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:4.original: No, Lydie. This is an investment in the future! It's our golden egg!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:4.translation: Нет, Лиди. Это инвестиция в будущее! Наше золотое яйцо!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:5.original: A golden egg? Yes! That's a good way to think of it!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:5.translation: Золотое яйцо? Да! Хороший взгляд на вещи!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:6.original: The expense hurts, sure, but we'll make many times this back. Right?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:6.translation: Трата, конечно, больно бьёт, но мы вернём во много раз больше. Правда?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:7.original: That's right. That's the way to think about it!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:7.translation: Именно. Вот так и надо думать!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:8.original: Yep! Hahah! Let's go and show this to Dad.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:9.original: Oh, good idea! Get ready, Dad. We're going to knock your socks off!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_050.ebm:9.translation: О, отличная идея! Готовься, папа. Мы тебя поразим!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:0.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:0.original: Hahaha! Take a look at this!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:1.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:1.original: What! That's a Business License! The one that's so expensive, people say it's surely a rip-off?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:1.translation: Что! Это лицензия на ведение бизнеса! Та самая дорогущая, про которую говорят — чистый обман?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:2.original: Yeah, I thought it was too expensive...
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:2.translation: Да, я тоже думала, что это слишком дорого...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:3.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:3.original: What about it? You didn't buy that, did you?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:3.translation: И что? Вы же её не купили?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:4.original: Yes, we did. Dad, this is the age of the big shops! That's what we need!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:4.translation: Купили. Папа, настал век больших магазинов! Вот что нам нужно!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:5.original: We've decided to open a big store, bring in lots of customers and become rich!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:5.translation: Мы решили открыть большой магазин, привлечь кучу покупателей и разбогатеть!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:6.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:6.original: Alright... If that's your decision, I'll follow it.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:6.translation: Хорошо... Если вы так решили, я вас поддержу.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:7.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:7.original: From now on, it's going to cost you so much you'll come to think that license was cheap... But oh well, good luck.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:7.translation: Дальше расходы будут такими, что эта лицензия покажется дешёвой... Ну да ладно, удачи.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:10.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:10.original: Running a larger store costs much more money by itself. Nothing like the small store we run now.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:10.translation: Содержать крупный магазин само по себе стоит куда больше. Совсем не то, что наш маленький сейчас.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:12.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:12.original: First, the construction cost of expanding the atelier. You'll also need more shelves and things to sell.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:12.translation: Во-первых, строительство — расширение ателье. Плюс больше полок и товаров на продажу.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:13.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:13.original: If you start hiring staff that will cost you, too, and extra synthesis will increase supplies expenses.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:13.translation: Если наймёте персонал — тоже расходы, а лишний синтез поднимет затраты на расходники.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:14.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:14.original: The tax on a large store is expensive, too. The bill will make your eyes pop!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:14.translation: Налог на большой магазин тоже высокий. От счёта глаза на лоб полезут!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:15.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:15.original: Bring it together and you're looking at a start up of millions of Coll. Then there's monthly costs...
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:15.translation: Сложите всё вместе — стартовые миллионы колл. А ещё ежемесячные расходы...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:17.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:17.original: I-I had no idea it was going to cost that much...
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:17.translation: Я-я и не думала, что выйдет так дорого...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:18.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:18.original: The world is a harsh place. If you want to get rich, gradual saving might be the best.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:18.translation: Мир суров. Если хотите разбогатеть, лучше копить постепенно.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:19.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:19.original: Hey! We only started down this path because you use up too much money, Dad!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:19.translation: Эй! Мы на это пошли только потому, что ты слишком много тратишь, папа!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:20.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:20.original: Oh. Sounds like it's time for me to retreat.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:21.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:21.original: Boy. What do you think, Sue?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:22.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:22.original: I-I'm not giving up! Whatever it costs, we just have to make more than that!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:22.translation: Я-я не сдаюсь! Сколько бы ни стоило — нужно зарабатывать ещё больше!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:23.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:23.original: We've already paid for the license! We can't just throw that away.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:23.translation: Мы уже заплатили за лицензию! Нельзя просто выбросить её.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:24.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:24.original: Hahaha, you're right. Now we need to start saving in order to open the shop, then...
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_060.ebm:24.translation: Ха-ха-ха, ты права. Теперь нужно копить, чтобы открыть магазин, а значит...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:0.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:0.original: The shelves can go here... And then place the most eye-catching products here...
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:0.translation: Полки сюда... А самые броские товары — вот здесь...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:2.original: I'm planning the layout for our future shop. I want to get the plans figured out, while we can.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:2.translation: Планирую планировку нашего будущего магазина. Хочу разобраться с планами, пока есть время.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:3.original: What's this?! Play-it-by-ear Suelle is making plans for the future?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:3.translation: Что это?! Сюэль, которая всегда действует наобум, строит планы на будущее?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:4.original: Do you want to get filled full of holes?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:5.original: Hahaha, sorry! You're really passionate about this, though... You really want to be rich?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:5.translation: Ха-ха-ха, прости! Но ты правда этим увлечена... Так сильно хочешь разбогатеть?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:6.original: That's part of it, but I also think a shop is a good way to become alchemists who work for all.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:6.translation: Отчасти да, но ещё думаю: магазин — хороший способ стать алхимиками, которые работают для всех.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:7.original: If we make a lovely shop that many people will come to, and fill it with alchemy items...
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:7.translation: Если сделать прекрасный магазин, куда пойдёт много людей, и наполнить его алхимическими товарами...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:8.original: That should bring the items we make to even more people, right?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:8.translation: Тогда то, что мы делаем, дойдёт до ещё большего числа людей, правда?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:9.original: Ah, good point! If we sell a lot of our items, that's one way to bring them to lots of people!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:9.translation: Ах, верно! Если продавать много своих товаров — это один из способов донести их до людей!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:10.original: Right! So that's why I want to open a big store in the future!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:10.translation: Точно! Поэтому я и хочу в будущем открыть большой магазин!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:11.original: Ah, of course together with you, Lydie. The shop run by two cute sisters!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:11.translation: Ах, конечно, вместе с тобой, Лидия. Магазин двух милых сестёр!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:12.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:12.original: Hehe, that sounds lovely! In which case, we need to keep on saving our money!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:12.translation: Хе-хе, звучит чудесно! Тогда нужно и дальше копить!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:13.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:13.original: Uwah, I know, I know! No luxuries, economy is key, snacks once a day... And then...
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:13.translation: Ува, знаю, знаю! Никакой роскоши, экономия прежде всего, перекус раз в день... И ещё...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:14.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:14.original: Hehe. A shop with Sue... I sure hope that day does come.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_070.ebm:14.translation: Хе-хе. Магазин со Сью... Очень надеюсь, что этот день наступит.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:1.original: Hey. You're painting, Lydie? You seem happy!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:1.translation: Эй. Ты рисуешь, Лиди? Ты какая-то счастливая!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:2.original: Yes. Dad gave me a canvas. What should I create? Oh, it's very exciting!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:2.translation: Да. Папа дал мне холст. Что же создать? Ох, как волнующе!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:3.original: Hahaha, I know that feeling. A blank canvas is so appealing!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:3.translation: Ха-ха-ха, знаю это чувство. Пустой холст так манит!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:4.original: Creating your own world from nothing. I love that feeling!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:4.translation: Создавать свой мир из ничего. Обожаю это ощущение!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:5.original: Me too! Oh, wait a second... How did you put it? Your own world?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:5.translation: Я тоже! Ой, подожди секунду... Как ты сказала? Свой мир?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:6.original: Hey, Sue. I have an idea. I want to try creating a Mysterious Painting!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:6.translation: Эй, Сью. У меня идея. Хочу попробовать создать Таинственную картину!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:7.original: What! W-Where did that come from?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:8.original: You just said "create your own world", didn't you?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:8.translation: Ты же только что сказала «создать свой мир», правда?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:9.original: To have our own world inside a painting, and then go on adventures there! That would be great!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:9.translation: Иметь свой мир внутри картины — и ходить туда в приключения! Было бы здорово!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:10.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:10.original: My mind is made up. I want to draw Mysterious Paintings! Heheh!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:10.translation: Решено. Хочу рисовать Таинственные картины! Хе-хе!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:11.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:11.original: Hahaha, that sounds pretty good! It should be interesting!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:11.translation: Ха-ха-ха, звучит довольно неплохо! Должно быть интересно!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:12.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:12.original: D-Dad, you too? I don't think this is possible!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:12.translation: П-папа, ты тоже? Мне кажется, это невозможно!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:13.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:13.original: Promise with Mom Number 1! "Don't give up before you even try..." Ow!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:13.translation: Обещание маме номер один! «Не сдавайся, даже не попробовав...» Ай!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:15.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:15.original: Hehe, you've got me fired up now. Really fired up, Dad! Is this the fire of creativity?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:15.translation: Хе-хе, ты меня теперь завела. Прям зажглась, папа! Это огонь творчества?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:16.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:16.original: I think so. You're really getting into this, aren't you, Lydie?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:16.translation: Похоже на то. Ты правда этим увлеклась, да, Лиди?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:17.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:17.original: Oh well. I guess it would be cool if we could make Mysterious Paintings...
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:17.translation: Ну ладно. Было бы круто, если б мы смогли делать Таинственные картины...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:18.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:18.original: I'm just not sure about your art style, Lydie... But alright!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_080.ebm:18.translation: Я просто не уверена насчёт твоего стиля, Лиди... Но ладно!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:0.original: Hmmm. Another failure... This one isn't a Mysterious Painting, either.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:0.translation: Хм. Очередная неудача... Это тоже не Таинственная картина.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:1.original: It isn't going to be easy, is it? Are you using Neige's Paints?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:1.translation: Непросто, да? Ты пользуешься Красками Нейдж?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:3.original: What do you think, Dad? You're the one with the experience here.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:3.translation: Что думаешь, папа? У тебя же есть опыт.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:4.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:4.original: Good question. Are you clearly visualizing the world you want to create?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:4.translation: Хороший вопрос. Чётко ли вы представляете мир, который хотите создать?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:5.original: I don't think there's a problem there. Lydie's paintings are totally her own unique little world.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:5.translation: Думаю, с этим проблем нет. Картины Лиди — это её собственный уникальный мирок.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:7.original: What do you mean by that? And you, Dad, how does that just make sense to you?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:7.translation: Что ты этим хочешь сказать? А ты, папа, почему сразу соглашаешься?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:8.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:8.original: Now it's just a case of lack of practice, then... Paint enough and you'll get there eventually.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:8.translation: Значит, просто нехватка практики... Рисуй достаточно — и рано или поздно получится.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:9.original: You think that's all? Lydie is pretty lucky, so I thought she'd get it pretty soon?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:9.translation: Думаешь, только в этом дело? Лиди ведь везучая, я думала, у неё быстро выйдет?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:10.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:10.original: Hey, don't underestimate Mysterious Paintings. Many have tried, few have painted even one.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:10.translation: Эй, не стоит недооценивать Таинственные картины. Многие пробовали — мало кто написал хотя бы одну.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:11.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:11.original: Painting one is a miracle of miracles. I know how lucky I got, believe me.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:11.translation: Написать одну — чудо из чудес. Я знаю, как мне повезло, поверь.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:12.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:12.original: No matter how lucky Lydie is, there's a lot of hard work involved in this task.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:12.translation: Как бы ни везло Лиди, для этой задачи нужен большой труд.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:13.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:13.original: Yes, you're right. I just want to get inside that painting, though!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:13.translation: Да, ты прав. Но я просто хочу попасть внутрь этой картины!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:14.original: Is there nothing else we can do? How about asking Neige?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:14.translation: Неужели больше ничего нельзя сделать? Может, спросить Нейдж?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:15.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:15.original: Neige? You mean Neige Chintreuil? I hate to break it to you, girls, but she's been dead for a long time.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:15.translation: Нейдж? Ты про Нейдж Шантрёй? Ненавижу это говорить, девочки, но она уже давно мертва.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:16.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:16.original: Hahah, actually! Just like mom, Neige is also living inside a painting even now!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:16.translation: Ха-ха, а на самом деле! Как и мама, Нейдж до сих пор живёт внутри картины!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:17.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:17.original: Seriously? I guess she was the one who created the Mysterious Paintings, after all. Impressive!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:17.translation: Серьёзно? Ну да, в конце концов именно она создала Таинственные картины. Впечатляет!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:18.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:18.original: If that's true, though, then you should go and ask her! She might have some unique insights.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:18.translation: Если так — ступайте и спросите её! У неё могут быть особые советы.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:19.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:19.original: Yes! Let's go! For our own worlds of paintings!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:19.translation: Да! Пойдём! За свои собственные миры в картинах!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:20.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:20.original: It's rare for Lydie to get so passionate about something... I need to back her up however I can!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_090.ebm:20.translation: Редко Лиди так чем-то загорается... Нужно поддержать её, как только могу!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:0.speaker: Neige
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:0.original: Hey! Have you come to play again?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:1.original: Actually, we're here to ask you a question today. Is there a secret to making Mysterious Paintings?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:1.translation: Вообще-то сегодня мы пришли задать вопрос. Есть ли секрет создания Таинственных картин?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:3.original: That was quick! Really? What about drawing a magic circle on the canvas? Or mixing blood with the paint?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:3.translation: Быстро же! Правда? А нарисовать на холсте магический круг? Или смешать кровь с краской?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:4.speaker: Neige
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:4.original: Hey, alchemy isn't black magic! There's no secret to it, so I can't help you!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:4.translation: Эй, алхимия — это не чёрная магия! Никакого секрета нет, так что помочь не могу!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:5.speaker: Neige
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:5.original: You need to use Mysterious Paints, and paint while imagining the world you want to create.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:5.translation: Нужны Таинственные краски — и рисовать, представляя мир, который хотите создать.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:6.speaker: Neige
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:6.original: That's all. If you use the right steps then it shouldn't be all that hard.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:6.translation: Вот и всё. Если делать всё правильно, это не должно быть так уж сложно.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:7.original: Uwah, easy for you to say, Neige! I've tried lots of times already, and it's no good...
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:7.translation: Ува, тебе легко говорить, Нейдж! Я уже столько раз пробовала — и ничего...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:8.speaker: Neige
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:8.original: Lots of times? Hold on. What Mysterious Paints are you using?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:8.translation: Столько раз? Погоди. Какие Таинственные краски вы используете?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:10.speaker: Neige
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:10.original: That explains it, then. Who passed this pitiful recipe on after my death? Honestly!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:10.translation: Тогда всё ясно. Кто после моей смерти передал этот жалкий рецепт? Честное слово!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:12.speaker: Neige
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:12.original: That's right. These are only the concept model. I mean, they might be enough for a Restoration...
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:12.translation: Именно. Это лишь концептуальная модель. Для восстановления, может, и хватит...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:13.speaker: Neige
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:13.original: But for a new painting you need to use much better paints! Even I wouldn't be able to do it with these.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:13.translation: Но для новой картины нужны куда лучшие краски! Даже я с этими бы не справилась.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:14.original: What?! Well that was totally unexpected!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:15.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:15.original: Hahaha! So... if someone did make a Mysterious Painting with these, they are pretty impressive, right?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:15.translation: Ха-ха-ха! Значит... если кто-то всё же написал Таинственную картину этими — он впечатляет, да?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:16.speaker: Neige
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:16.original: Yeah, I guess so... They must be a pretty hard worker...
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:16.translation: Да, наверное... Должен быть очень трудолюбивым...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:17.speaker: Neige
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:17.original: Anyway. If you really want to make Mysterious Paintings then you need to improve your paints.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:17.translation: Как бы то ни было. Если хотите делать Таинственные картины — улучшайте краски.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:18.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:18.original: What? You aren't going to tell us the recipe you used, Neige?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:18.translation: Что? Ты не расскажешь нам свой рецепт, Нейдж?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:19.speaker: Neige
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:19.original: No, I'm not. It'll be more personal if you think of the recipe yourself, won't it?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:19.translation: Нет. Будет личнее, если рецепт придумаете сами, правда?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:20.speaker: Neige
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:20.original: These paintings are alchemy, too. Feelings are key! Fill the paints with your intentions!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:20.translation: Эти картины — тоже алхимия. Чувства — главное! Наполните краски своими намерениями!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:21.speaker: Neige
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:21.original: If you can do that, I think you'll be able to spread your own colors across a white world.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:21.translation: Если получится — думаю, вы сможете разнести свои цвета по белому миру.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:22.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:22.original: I see... Thanks, Neige! I'll try improving the paints, then!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:22.translation: Понятно... Спасибо, Нейдж! Тогда попробую улучшить краски!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:23.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:23.original: Once the painting is finished, I'll invite you over to my world, Neige! Just wait and see!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_100.ebm:23.translation: Когда картина будет готова, приглашу тебя в свой мир, Нейдж! Только подожди — увидишь!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:0.original: Improve the paints. Fill them with my desires!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:0.translation: Улучшить краски. Наполнить их своими желаниями!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:1.original: Don't overthink it, Sis. The most important thing is, what do you want to paint?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:1.translation: Не зацикливайся, сестрёнка. Главное — что ты хочешь нарисовать?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:2.original: What do I want to paint... I want to create a painting that everyone can enjoy!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:2.translation: Что я хочу нарисовать... Хочу создать картину, которой все смогут радоваться!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:3.original: A fun world... I think that would make everyone happy!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:3.translation: Весёлый мир... Думаю, это сделает всех счастливыми!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:4.original: Hahaha, that sounds lovely! I'd like to paint something like that too.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:4.translation: Ха-ха-ха, звучит чудесно! Я бы тоже хотела такое нарисовать.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:5.original: Let's hold on to those feelings and think of a new recipe!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:5.translation: Давай сохраним эти чувства и придумаем новый рецепт!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:7.original: Good. I think this should do it!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:8.original: Great! We created this together, after all! A recipe from us both means double the power!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:8.translation: Отлично! Ведь мы создали это вместе! Рецепт от нас обеих — двойная сила!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:9.original: Yeah, you're right. We need to remember this feeling when we synthesize, too.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_110.ebm:9.translation: Да, ты права. Нужно помнить это чувство и при синтезе.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:0.original: We've done it! The improved "Neige's Paints"!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:1.original: Well done, Lydie! I'm so glad it worked out!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:1.translation: Молодец, Лиди! Я так рада, что всё вышло!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:2.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:2.original: Ah! Are these the new paints? Hmm, they don't look all that different?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:2.translation: Ах! Это новые краски? Хм, с виду почти не отличаются?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:3.original: Hehe, don't judge based on appearance. The emotions poured into these is totally different!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:3.translation: Хе-хе, не суди по виду. Эмоции, вложенные в них, совсем другие!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:4.original: Yep, that's right. With these, I can do it!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:4.translation: Ага, именно. С ними я смогу!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:5.original: Come then, Lydie the artist! Madam Lydie! Create your first masterpiece!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:5.translation: Ну же, Лиди-художница! Госпожа Лиди! Создай свой первый шедевр!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:6.original: Yes, leave it to me! Right, canvas, easel, go!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:6.translation: Да, оставь на меня! Итак, холст, мольберт — вперёд!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:7.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:7.original: Hold it. Hold on. I don't think you should use those paints yet.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:7.translation: Стоп. Погоди. Думаю, этими красками пока лучше не пользоваться.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:8.original: What? Why not? We're just about to create a Mysterious Painting!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:8.translation: Что? Почему? Мы же как раз собираемся создать Таинственную картину!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:9.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:9.original: Oh my, this isn't easy to say, but it might be a bigger problem if you do manage to create one, you know?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:9.translation: Ох, нелегко это говорить, но если вам вдруг удастся — проблем может стать ещё больше, понимаете?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:10.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:10.original: I'm not sure I do. What do you mean, a problem?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:10.translation: Не уверена, что понимаю. Что значит — проблема?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:11.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:11.original: Once, a very "unique", shall we say, artist managed to complete a Mysterious Painting...
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:11.translation: Однажды очень «своеобразный», скажем так, художник сумел завершить Таинственную картину...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:12.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:12.original: The world inside, though, was... let's just say, a little better than a tipped over alchemy cauldron.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:12.translation: Мир внутри, впрочем... скажем так, был лишь чуть лучше опрокинутого алхимического котла.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:13.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:13.original: Those who went inside had a very difficult time... Do you see now?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:13.translation: Тем, кто зашёл внутрь, пришлось очень тяжело... Теперь понимаете?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:14.original: In other words, because Lydie is so bad at painting, if she actually does manage to create a Mysterious Painting...
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:14.translation: Другими словами, раз Лиди так плохо рисует, если ей вдруг удастся создать Таинственную картину...

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:15.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:15.original: ... It could end bad. Inexperienced artists can't be going around making Mysterious Paintings.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:15.translation: ...Может кончиться плохо. Неопытным художникам нельзя разбрасываться Таинственными картинами.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:16.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:16.original: I stopped you going into the Heavenly Flower Garden because I was worried about my own work.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:16.translation: Я не пускал тебя в Небесный цветочный сад, потому что волновался за свою работу.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:17.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:17.original: I see. If even Dad was worried, maybe you shouldn't do it, Lydie?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:17.translation: Понятно. Если даже папа волновался — может, не стоит, Лиди?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:18.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:18.original: Gah! You just come out and say I draw badly?! I'm not stopping! I'm mad! I'll keep practicing!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:18.translation: Гах! Вы прямо так и говорите, что я плохо рисую?! Я не остановлюсь! Я зла! Буду тренироваться дальше!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:19.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:19.original: I'll practice so much I'll become better than you, Sue, and even you, Dad!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:19.translation: Буду тренироваться так упорно, что обгоню и тебя, Сью, и даже тебя, папа!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:20.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:20.original: Then I'll paint a Mysterious Painting that will make everyone happy!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:20.translation: И тогда нарисую Таинственную картину, которая всех осчастливит!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:21.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:21.original: Ah, we upset her. You shouldn't have said she can't draw, Dad!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:21.translation: Ах, мы её расстроили. Не надо было говорить, что она не умеет рисовать, папа!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:22.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:22.original: Hey! I didn't say that. I actually quite like her paintings.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:22.translation: Эй! Я этого не говорил. Мне вообще очень нравятся её картины.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:23.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:23.original: But if you're going to make a Mysterious Painting, you at least need a sketch first!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:23.translation: Но если уж делать Таинственную картину — сначала нужен хотя бы эскиз!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:24.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:24.original: Hmm, okay. Maybe I'll start practicing art too?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:24.translation: Хм, ладно. Может, я тоже начну практиковаться в рисовании?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:25.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:25.original: That sounds like a good idea. You've got those paints, now.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:25.translation: Хорошая идея. Краски у вас теперь есть.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:26.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:26.original: In the future you could even become known as sisters who paint Mysterious Paintings!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:26.translation: В будущем вас даже могут знать как сестёр, что пишут Таинственные картины!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:27.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:27.original: Hehe, I think I like the sound of that!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_120.ebm:27.translation: Хе-хе, мне нравится, как это звучит!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:0.original: Uwah, dummy-daddy! Taking all these jobs on and then not doing them!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:0.translation: Ува, глупый папа! Нахватать заказов — и ничего не делать!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:1.original: Hey, if you've got time to cry you've got time to synthesize! We really aren't going to make it!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:1.translation: Эй, если есть время плакать — есть время синтезировать! Мы правда не успеем!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:2.original: Waaah! This is hopeless, really hopeless! How can we hope to make it in time?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:2.translation: Вааа! Всё безнадёжно, совсем безнадёжно! Как же нам успеть?!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:3.original: It's no good, Lydie is out of commission! I'll have to handle this alone!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:3.translation: Бесполезно, Лиди вышла из строя! Придётся справляться одной!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:5.original: I'm sorry, Sue. I lost my head again.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:5.translation: Прости, Сью. Я снова потеряла голову.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:6.original: Hahaha, don't worry about it! It isn't your fault, Lydie.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:6.translation: Ха-ха-ха, не переживай! Это не твоя вина, Лиди.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:7.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:7.original: I'm sorry, too, Sue. Pushing all my work onto you two.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:7.translation: И мне жаль, Сью. Свалил всю работу на вас двоих.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:8.original: It's your fault! I'm not forgiving you today!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:8.translation: Это твоя вина! Сегодня я тебя не прощу!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:9.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:9.original: Alright, alright, wait. I'll take responsibility this time. I do feel bad!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:9.translation: Ладно, ладно, подожди. На этот раз я возьму ответственность на себя. Мне и правда неловко!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:10.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:10.original: I even got you this gift, not a bribe, just something to say how sorry I am! Here!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:10.translation: Я даже принёс подарок — не взятку, просто чтобы сказать, как мне жаль! Вот!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:12.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:12.original: Come on, Sue. Forgive your old dad, will you?
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:12.translation: Ну же, Сью. Простишь старого папу?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:13.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:13.original: I guess I can, this time. But never again!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:13.translation: На этот раз, пожалуй, да. Но больше никогда!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:14.original: Wow, that's so cute! It just needs a ribbon and it would be even cuter!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:14.translation: Вау, так мило! Только ленточку — и будет ещё милее!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:16.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:16.original: Dad, you're the worst! No more food for you, for life!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:16.translation: Папа, ты худший! Больше никакой еды тебе — на всю жизнь!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:17.speaker: Roger
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:17.original: For life! Lydie? Hey, Lydie! Forgive me! Wait, please! I'm begging you!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_130.ebm:17.translation: На всю жизнь! Лиди? Эй, Лиди! Прости! Подожди, пожалуйста! Умоляю!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:0.original: Hey, Lydie. Found anything over there?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:1.translation: Неа. А что у тебя, Сью?

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:2.original: Not a thing! Boy, this looks bad.<CR>We need to do something!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:2.translation: Ничего! Боже, это плохо.<CR>Надо что-то делать!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:3.original: I know. If we don't find some ingredients soon we won't have anything to eat tomorrow!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:3.translation: Знаю. Если мы сейчас не найдём какие-нибудь ингредиенты, завтра нам будет нечего есть!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:4.original: Argh! I can't stand that bitter uni soup anymore!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:4.translation: Ааа! Я больше не могу терпеть этот горький суп из уни!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:5.original: Hahaha, me either. We should just search some more.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:5.translation: Ха-ха-ха, я тоже. Нам нужно просто поискать ещё.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:6.original: Well said, Sis! I'll leave this in your capable hands!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:6.translation: Хорошо сказано, сестрёнка! Я оставлю это в твоих умелых руках!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:7.original: Hold it! No way, Sister! You're helping me too!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:7.translation: Подожди! Не так быстро, сестра! Ты мне тоже помогаешь!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:8.original: Bah! Alright! Don't make a big thing about it!
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:8.translation: Ба! Хорошо! Не делай из мухи слона!

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:10.speaker: System
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:10.original: Press <IM00> close to a sparkling object to <CLEG>gather<CLNR> materials.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:10.translation: Нажмите <IM00> рядом со сверкающим объектом, чтобы <CLEG>собрать<CLNR> материалы.

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:11.speaker: System
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:11.original: <CLR1>Start by gathering as many materials as you can find nearby!<CLNR>
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:11.translation: <CLR1>Начните со сбора как можно большего количества материалов, которые сможете найти поблизости!<CLNR>

ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:12.speaker: System
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:12.original: You can play the game again from the start, using your equipment from your cleared game.
ebm:qc01/event_message_qc01_150.ebm:12.translation: Вы можете пройти игру снова с самого начала, используя снаряжение из пройденного прохождения.
